latest_repo_validation.scope: PR image build, metadata, Trivy, API and worker image health; not registry publish proof

staging.note: Repository CI proved the isolated PostgreSQL/Redis/Bearer-auth staging topology. A real externally deployed production-like staging environment and build-once promotion lifecycle are not confirmed by this evidence.

production.note: No authoritative production deployment evidence is retained in the repository readiness manifest.

latest_repo_restore_drill.scope: PostgreSQL logical backup, isolated restore, schema and deterministic data fingerprint verification

observability.note: Backend observability controls exist in the repository, but production-grade end-to-end observability, mobile crash reporting and a retained staging alert-delivery probe are not yet proven complete.

legal_privacy.note: Terms/Privacy, retention, export/delete, subprocessors, payment/legal and jurisdiction validation require external approval evidence.

manual_payment_evidence.note: Current main has paid_unverified transfer acknowledgement, but not the complete evidence upload, authorized reviewer approve/reject, safe resubmission and single-recognition financial lifecycle.

warranty_claim_idempotency.note: Warranty create remains retryable/offline-capable without a durable create idempotency identity, leaving duplicate issue/document/event risk.

chat_read_truth.note: GET/list/count are side-effect-free; explicit server-resolved read cursor advances monotonically; mobile read receipt is foreground/focus/render/overlay gated; ACK reconciliation is fail-closed and project-switch safe. Exact head passed full backend regression, Playwright API/UI, CodeQL, mobile/typecheck contracts and PostgreSQL Alembic upgrade.

chat_read_equal_timestamp_cursor.note: Canonical read state still persists a timestamp after resolving the exact message id; equal-timestamp messages can coalesce at that boundary. A future schema extension must add a stable total-order cursor without creating a second read-state truth source.

phone_chat_invitation_delivery.note: Phone-only chat invitation currently swallows SMS provider failures and can return a false successful state. Delivery intent must become atomic, durable and observable through the canonical DomainOutbox/worker pattern.

archived_chat_new_message_visibility.note: Archived threads are excluded from global unread, while a new incoming message does not currently restore recipient visibility. Archive/read/mute semantics and the incoming-message transition must be made deterministic and race-safe.

launch_decision.reason: Broad production remains blocked by external staging/promotion, disaster recovery, observability/alerting, governance, capacity, provider, product-integrity, pilot/legal/operations and security evidence gaps.
